clips.title: HIP walk forward
clips.passCriterion: Keep the step timing and the figure-8 path. Deepen the lows at about 0.15s and 0.48s by about another tenth of the reference, and again on the second loop.

clips.title: HIP walk backward
clips.passCriterion: Keep the side sway and its timing. Widen and deepen the drop arcs at about 0.45s to 0.48s and add stronger roll at those troughs, and again on the second loop.

clips.title: HIP strafe left
clips.passCriterion: Keep the timing and the rightward travel. Increase the inward yaw and roll on the leftward upswing around 0.50s to 0.70s so the barrel angles in like the reference.

clips.title: HIP strafe right
clips.passCriterion: Keep the left-then-right timing and the roll. Deepen the vertical dips at the side peaks around 0.30s and 0.70s.

clips.title: Forward ADS v4
clips.passCriterion: It needs its own ADS walk, sights locked on center, almost no side yaw, and a tighter vertical bounce.

clips.title: Backward ADS v4
clips.passCriterion: It needs its own ADS walk backward, sights locked on center, and a path that reads as backward instead of a wide figure-8.

clips.title: Left ADS v4
clips.passCriterion: It needs its own ADS strafe left, sights locked on center, and no rightward overshoot.

clips.title: Right ADS v4
clips.passCriterion: It needs its own ADS strafe, sights locked on center, a rightward path with no left overshoot, and a fast shallow bounce.

clips.title: Forward ADS v5 trial 1
clips.passCriterion: Keep the sight lock. Restore a dedicated ADS forward walk with the reference's shallow footfall and cadence. The bottom is nearly still.

clips.title: Forward ADS v6 trial 1
clips.passCriterion: Keep the sight lock. Restore a dedicated ADS forward walk with the reference’s shallow, sharp footfall and cadence. The bottom is still nearly still.

clips.title: Left ADS lateral trial 1
clips.passCriterion: Drive left strafe from dedicated ADS locomotion, not HIP r1 under an ADS pose. Lock sights on center. Replace the wide figure-8 with a tight left-strafe drag and reference-scale bounce at about 0.50s and 0.95s.

clips.title: Right ADS lateral trial 1
clips.passCriterion: Drive right strafe from dedicated ADS locomotion, not HIP r1 under an ADS pose. Lock sights on center. Replace the pendulum figure-8 with a braced right path and sharp shallow dips at about 0.33s and 1.00s.
